text:
chen: Heads up — after bringing lynx-lite-v0.3 (int8) into staging, our multilang eval shows a notable BLEU drop for zh-Hant and an Arabic RTL punctuation flip. Putting results here for quick triage.

eval-bot: automated-eval summary:
  - baseline: lynx-base-fp16
    zh-Hant BLEU: 34.2
    ar BLEU: 29.1
  - candidate: lynx-lite-v0.3-int8
    zh-Hant BLEU: 28.7  (-5.5)
    ar BLEU: 24.0     (-5.1)
  - tokenization mismatch rate (zh-Hant): +2.8%
  - bidi mark drops (ar): +1.6%
  (evalset: trad-news / open-subtitles mix, n=3k)

sara: Can you paste a tiny repro example?

chen: Sure — smallest failing trad-chinese example below (ref vs outputs). Note the fullwidth punctuation/spacing:

```
src:  他在演講裡說，台灣需要更多投資。
ref:  他在演講裡說，台灣需要更多投資。
base:  他在演講裡說，台灣需要更多投資。
cand:  他在演講裡說 ， 台灣 需要 更多 投資 。
```

chen: Candidate output has spaces inserted before/after punctuation and also splits tokens oddly which hurts detokenized BLEU.

michael: That looks suspiciously like a normalization/tokenizer change in the int8 build. We recently toggled the "compat_width_normalize" flag to true for smaller vocab surface (to help q4/q5 packing).

rahul: If compat_width_normalize (NFKC-ish) was applied at the wrong stage it can turn fullwidth comma U+FF0C into ascii comma + spacing. Can you check token ids?

chen: Did a quick check:
```
# staging: lynx-lite-v0.3-int8
tokenizer.encode('，') -> [50291]
# baseline: lynx-base-fp16
tokenizer.encode('，') -> [1123]
```
So token id changed for the same glyph in the int8 build.

nora: Oof. For Arabic I also have a minimal sample:
```
src:  هذا اختبار بسيط، هل يظهر التحية؟
ref:  هذا اختبار بسيط، هل يظهر التحية؟
base:  هذا اختبار بسيط، هل يظهر التحية؟
cand:  ،هذا اختبار بسيط هل يظهر التحية
```
Candidate puts the Arabic comma at the front (commas reorder) — looks like bidi control or mark stripping during preprocessing.

michael: That suggests the tokenization or pre-token normalization removed RLM/LRM or U+200F marks or reordered them. Could be our "strip_invisible" pass in the int8 tokenizer pipeline. We added that to reduce vocab tail noise.

rahul: Quick repro commands to run locally:
```
python -m ci.eval --model=lynx-lite-v0.3-int8 --evalset=trad-news --lang=zh-Hant --samples=100
python -m ci.eval --model=lynx-base-fp16  --evalset=trad-news --lang=zh-Hant --samples=100
# for direct API smoke
curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/completions -H "Authorization: Bearer $STAGING" -d '{"model":"lynx-lite-v0.3-int8","input":"他在演講裡說，台灣需要更多投資。"}'
```

eval-bot: attached tokenization diffs for first 50 examples (uploaded to S3 at s3://redwood-ci/lynx-lite-int8-token-diffs/1773334444.tar.gz)

chen: I'm going to roll a canary that disables compat_width_normalize and strip_invisible on staging to see if metrics recover. Will also attach minimal failing examples to INF ticket.

sara: Sounds good. If disabling those flags fixes detok BLEU, we should revert the tokenizer change in int8 packaging and then rerun quantization with the sanitized pipeline.

michael: I'll open an infra ticket to check packaging hooks that might run a different tokenizer binary into the int8 container — INF-8241 (putting link in the ticket later).

chen: Thanks — I'll run the bisect and update here. If anyone has quick kernel suspects (we also changed an assembly kernel for int8 matmul last week) ping me. :eyes:

nora: I'll grep eval logs for other languages (ko/ja) to see if the whitespace insertion is broader.

chen: Great — will update by EOD with canary results and attach the S3 bundle. Appreciated! :thumbsup:
